description: Find public LinkedIn vacancies. Not jobs across sources: use search_jobs. Required: field.

exp_level.description: Experience filter: internship, entry_level, associate, mid_senior_level or director; omitted means all levels. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

field.description: Required job title or company keyword, e.g. Python developer; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

filter_by_company.description: LinkedIn company ID; omitted means all companies. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

geoid.description: LinkedIn location ID; default 92000000 (worldwide). No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

job_type.description: Employment filter: temporary, contract, volunteer, full_time or part_time; omitted means all types. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

location.description: Location text, e.g. London; omit for worldwide jobs. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

page.description: One-based result page, integer at least 1; default 1. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

sort_by.description: Posting-date filter: day, week or month; omitted means no date filter. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

work_type.description: Work model: at_work, remote or hybrid; omitted means all models. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: search_linkedin_jobs
title: LinkedIn public job listings
